decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024 as a multi-model line close to the firm's core automation offer, it has had too little time to fall short of aspirations, and a growing industry gives the slack to carry it, though the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows management prunes and repackages its robotic offerings readily.

Production analysis software complements the firm's control and lifecycle-service business at low carrying cost, so with no evidence of a shortfall and adequate slack there is little trigger for problemistic search to drop it.
